messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Converting theta scale in plots
parts:
Hi Keri,

The plotting functions in mirt are unfortunately limited to the theta metric and cannot be changed for numerical reasons. They are lattice-based plots though, so you replace the x-axis to be something different if you save the plot to and object first (e.g., plt <- itemplot(mod, 1); str(plt); plt$edit$some <- stuff). Alternatively, you could try some of mirt's secondary functions such as probtrace, expected.item(), etc, to create the plots that you want. 

Phil
